# Vendored animation runtime

- three-r128.min.js: Three.js 0.128.0, the same version used by templates/3d_viewer.html; MIT license in THREE-LICENSE.txt.
- gsap-3.13.0.min.js: GSAP 3.13.0; copyright and standard-license URL retained in its header (https://gsap.com/standard-license).

Fetched from the version-pinned public npm distribution at cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/. Served locally and loaded only for a generation transition; no CDN is required at runtime.
